tools.name: search_moments
tools.description: Find the moments in Bettyapp's university and school lectures that explain a topic or answer a student's question. Use it when a student asks about a topic, or is stuck on a question, and a short part of a real lecture would help. Call it first, with the topic's name (see query). Each moment has a p

tools.name: get_lecture
tools.description: One lecture on Bettyapp, by its id (lecture.id in a moment) or the address of its page: its course, teacher, Subjects and Levels, credit line, and every moment in it, in order, each with its play_url. Use it to give a student more of a lecture a moment came from, or to read a Bettyapp lecture link t

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: A topic (photosynthesis, chain rule, supply and demand): the best moment on Bettyapp that explains it at each Level, from school to university, then a few more and related topics. Call search_moments first; use get_topic when the student wants an explanation at a particular Level, or an easier or a

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: Every Subject with lectures on Bettyapp, each with its Levels and how many lectures it has, and the Level ladder from Elementary to Graduate & Professional. Use it to find the subject and level values for search_moments, or to tell a student what Bettyapp covers.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Bettyapp's university and school lectures for the moments that explain a topic or question. Returns results, best first, each with an id for fetch, a title and the url that opens the lecture at that moment. For a student, search_moments gives more (the summary, teacher and credit line). No re

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: One result of search by its id ("<lecture id>@<second>"), or a lecture by its id or the address of its page: the moment's title, summary, the questions it answers and the teacher's words at its start, its lecture and credit line, and the url that plays from it.

tools.name: find_related_moments
tools.description: Find the moments in Bettyapp's lectures whose meaning is close to the student's question as worded. It helps when the student does not know the topic's name ("why does e to the x stay the same when you differentiate it"). The moments are related to the question, not necessarily about the same topic:

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_moments" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
